US Treasury yields approach 4.8% amid fiscal risk concerns

US Treasury yields are testing the 4.8% mark, with fiscal risks potentially impacting other assets. Economists suggest that recent behavior in the 10-year Treasury yield indicates weaker-than-expected demand for US debt. This situation is described as an 'all-hands-on-deck situation' by a top economist, highlighting concerns about the escalating US debt.
